linguisticReviewScope: 259 whole before/after aids read with studied French, Chinese meaning and alignment; targeted changes only, not native certification

originalCatalogueTruncations.causeBound: Pre-existing in classic source; not introduced by generator or transport reuse. This identifies the data origin, not the historical editorial process that caused truncation.

metadataNotes.issue: afterPhon uses 比斯 for bus but reason still cites 布斯; description needs to follow frozen after
afterPhon uses 云 without optional z liaison after Fixons; reason still cites 祖讷
afterPhon uses 戎 while reason cites 雄; do not present cited candidate as actual after

openWholeAidReservations.issue: No explicit final-r cue in 楼特; Latin before LOHTR had an r. Check the convention/native rendering before claiming the entire new aid is phonemically complete. This is not a definite exclusion of the targeted script replacement.

The claimed repair of v remains an approximation through a Mandarin w-like onset, while 旺 also changes the vowel toward a/ang. Confirmation is needed for the vɔ̃ mapping; no acoustic claim of exact v restoration.

limitations: Chinese-character aids approximate French sounds absent in Mandarin; replacing a target segment does not certify every remaining segment
Liaison t after est/c’est may be retained as a pronunciation choice; do not relabel every such liaison as universally mandatory
v/vy, rounded-front vowels, nasals, supporting syllables and some final consonants remain convention/native-review questions
No rule may be extended automatically from these frozen events
